turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm organising a remote game night for my team at work. About eight people.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fun team bonding. Do you want a silly party game where people compete, or a co-op one where everyone works together?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sit tight for six seconds and then check in with me.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: So, competitive or co-op for your coworkers?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Party game. A bit of friendly rivalry is good for them.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Love it. Pick one that runs in a browser so nobody has to install anything.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Unrelated, but Are wireless charging pads worth it, or just a gimmick?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Depends on your habits. They're slower than a cable, but really handy on a desk or nightstand where you just drop the phone down.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm always unplugging my phone to text in bed and then it doesn't charge.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then a cable is actually better for you, since you can use the phone while it's plugged in. A pad only charges when the phone's lying on it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, one for the office then. Not the bedroom.
